name: EXM_EXPENSE_ERRORS
description: This table stores information about validations and policy violations that are used to create expenses errors and warnings.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense item exception.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense item with exceptions.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the user who created the expense item.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ERROR_STRING_CODE
columns.description: Error code of the exception message.

columns.name: ERROR_STRING_TEXT
columns.description: Exception message reported for the expense.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of the user who created the expense item.

columns.name: ATTENDEE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of associated expenses.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ATTENDEE_ID
columns.description: Attendee identifier for the associated expense.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display sequence within the card category.

columns.name: USER_ACTION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the user needs to perform some action on the expense item.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the user has acknowledged the policy violation.

columns.name: VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of policy violation, such as receipt missing, corporate card required, conversion rate, or category-based policy.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Grouping of expense types and additional data fields that are relevant for an expense group, such as airfare.

columns.name: WARNING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the exception is a warning or an error.

columns.name: VALIDATION_ERROR_MESSAGES
columns.description: Summary of errors reported for an expense item.

columns.name: VALIDATION_WARNING_MESSAGES
columns.description: Summary of warnings reported for an expense item.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of exception. Possible values are RowValidation, AttributeValidation, DffRowValidation or DffAttributeValidation.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code of the exception message.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Object for which the exception is generated.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: UI element for which the exception is generated.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the UI element for which the exception is generated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EXCEEDED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the expense exceeded the allowable amount limit causing a policy violation.

columns.name: ALLOWABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount allowed for the expense type by the company policy.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Policy identifier associated to the expense.

columns.name: POLICY_SOURCE
columns.description: Type of policy source, such as receipt missing, corporate card required, conversion rate, or category-based policy.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Reason an expense was incurred.

columns.name: DISPLAY_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether policy violations should be displayed to the user.

columns.name: TOKEN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the exception message contains a token.

columns.name: TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: Name or code of the token in the exception message.

columns.name: TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the token in the exception message.
